data.name: Nejat
data.gender_notes: Nejat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is rescued, saved, or delivers others from harm. The name Nejat carries the meaning “Safety, Salvation, Security” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nejat usually hope their child will grow to embody safety, salvation, security and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes protection and deliverance from harm, both physically and spiritually
data.etymology: Nejat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Safety, Salvation, Security.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nejat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Nejat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nejat is derived from the Arabic root ن-ج-ط, meaning salvation or deliverance. In Islamic tradition, salvation is considered a gift from Allah, and the name Nejat refers to this concept. It implies freedom from evil and harm, and is considered a noble name in Islamic culture. The name is also associated with the concept of spiritual deliverance, where an individual is rescued from the trap of evil desires and worldly distractions. In modern times, the name Nejat has been adopted by Muslims across the world, symbolizing the hope for salvation and deliverance from the troubles of this world.
